acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given data is imported from gomafia.pro, When each entity (game, player, tournament) is processed, Then the system validates required fields, data types, business rules, referential integrity; calculates quality score: (valid records / total records) × 100; logs validation results; rejects batches with quality score < 98%

Validation includes required field validation (name, date, ID, etc.), data format validation (date format, number ranges, string lengths), business logic validation (game outcome matches scores, role assignments valid), cross-reference validation (players exist, tournaments exist, clubs exist)

If quality threshold not met: import pauses and logs detailed validation errors, shows quality report to user with message "Data quality below threshold (X%). Please review errors.", provides option to continue anyway (user acknowledges risk) or fix errors

constraints.constraint: Clean Architecture: Validation logic in domain/infrastructure layers, ImportOrchestrator in infrastructure layer, validation tracking in services layer
TDD Approach: Write tests before implementation, follow Red-Green-Refactor cycle, maintain 80% test coverage minimum
Validation Threshold: Hard-coded 98% threshold in ValidationMetricsTracker.validationThreshold, use getSummary().meetsThreshold boolean for checks

Error Storage: Store validation metrics in SyncLog.errors JSON field. Structure: { validationMetrics: { validationRate, meetsThreshold, totalRecords, validRecords, invalidRecords, errorsByEntity }, integrity: { ... }, errors: [...] }
State Management: Use TanStack Query for server state (validation summary polling). Configuration in src/lib/queryClient.ts. Polling interval: 2 seconds when import running
UI Components: Use ShadCN/UI components from src/components/ui/: Card for report container, Badge for status indicators (green/red), Alert for warnings, Table for error list, Button for actions
Responsive Design: Mobile-first approach with breakpoints at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px
Accessibility: WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required, minimum 4.5:1 color contrast ratio for text

Testing Standards: Unit tests for ValidationMetricsTracker, IntegrityChecker, Zod schemas; integration tests for validation flow during import; E2E tests for validation report display; accessibility tests using @axe-core/playwright
Project Structure: Import/validation components in src/components/import/, API routes in src/app/api/gomafia-sync/import/, validation services in src/services/, custom hooks in src/hooks/

interface.name: ValidationMetricsTracker API
interface.signature: class ValidationMetricsTracker { recordValid(entity: string): void; recordInvalid(entity: string, message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>): void; getMetrics(): ValidationMetrics; getSummary(): ValidationSummary; getErrors(): ValidationError[]; }

interface.name: IntegrityChecker API
interface.signature: class IntegrityChecker { checkGameParticipationLinks(): Promise<IntegrityCheckResult>; checkAllIntegrity(): Promise<AllIntegrityResult>; getIntegritySummary(): Promise<IntegritySummary>; }

interface.name: Validation Summary API Endpoint
interface.signature: GET /api/gomafia-sync/import/validation - Returns: { validationRate: number; meetsThreshold: boolean; totalRecords: number; validRecords: number; invalidRecords: number; errorsByEntity: Record<string, number>; errors: ValidationError[]; integrity?: IntegritySummary; }

interface.name: useValidationSummary Hook
interface.signature: function useValidationSummary(): { data?: ValidationSummary; isLoading: boolean; error?: Error; } - Polls validation endpoint every 2 seconds when import is running

interface.name: ValidationQualityReport Component
interface.signature: function ValidationQualityReport({ summary }: { summary: ValidationSummary }): JSX.Element - Displays validation rate, counts, errors by entity type, integrity results, continue button if threshold not met

interface.name: ImportOrchestrator Integration Points

Use Vitest for unit/integration tests, Playwright for E2E tests, React Testing Library for component tests. Test types: unit tests for validation logic (ValidationMetricsTracker, IntegrityChecker, Zod schemas); integration tests for validation flow during import; E2E tests for validation report display; accessibility tests using @axe-core/playwright for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance verification.

ideas.idea: Test: ValidationMetricsTracker integration in ImportOrchestrator - Verify recordValid()/recordInvalid() called for all entity types (Clubs, Players, Games, Tournaments), verify validation metrics stored in SyncLog.errors after each phase, verify validation rate calculation matches formula: (validRecords / totalRecords) × 100

Test: Batch-level threshold check - Verify import pauses when validationRate < 98%, verify detailed errors logged when threshold not met, verify sync status updated to indicate validation failure, verify batch-level validation results stored in SyncLog.errors

Test: Enhanced IntegrityChecker - Verify GameParticipation.playerId references existing Player, verify GameParticipation.gameId references existing Game, verify Game.tournamentId references existing Tournament (if present), verify Player.clubId references existing Club (if present), verify Tournament.clubId references existing Club (if present), verify integrity failures reported correctly

Test: Zod schema validation - Verify required field validation (non-null, non-empty), verify data type validation (dates, numbers, strings), verify format validation (date format, number ranges, string lengths), verify business rule validation (positive scores, valid date ranges, valid role assignments), verify validation failures recorded in ValidationMetricsTracker

Test: Validation API endpoint - Verify GET /api/gomafia-sync/import/validation returns correct validation summary with validationRate, meetsThreshold, totalRecords, validRecords, invalidRecords, errorsByEntity, recent errors (last 50), integrity check results if available, verify endpoint handles missing sync log gracefully

Test: ValidationQualityReport component - Verify displays validation rate with visual indicator (green if ≥98%, red if <98%), verify shows total/valid/invalid record counts, verify displays errors grouped by entity type, verify shows detailed error list with entity, message, context, verify shows integrity check results if available, verify "Continue Anyway" button appears if threshold not met with confirmation dialog, verify component handles missing data gracefully, verify component is accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA)

Test: Integration with sync status page - Verify ValidationQualityReport displays on import status page, verify warning displays when threshold not met, verify continue action works correctly, verify validation report fetched using TanStack Query hook, verify polling updates every 2 seconds when import running

Test: Complete validation flow E2E - Import with high-quality data (≥98%) → Verify import succeeds, validation rate displayed, validation report shows success. Import with low-quality data (<98%) → Verify import pauses, validation errors logged, report displayed with errors, user can acknowledge and continue. Referential integrity validation → Verify broken references detected and reported. Zod schema validation → Verify invalid fields caught and logged.

Test: Validation metrics in sync completion notifications - Verify validation rate included in sync completion summary, verify validation status badge displayed (Excellent if ≥98%, Warning if <98%), verify validation metrics shown in toast notification or summary card
